channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-134665 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory by supplying a crafted XMT file. When xmt_parse_element() replaces an SFNode field child, the freed node stays cached in parser->peeked_nodes and a later DEF lookup passes it to gf_node_get_name(), crashing MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134666 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader because xmt_node_end() frees unattached nodes but leaves them on the parser node stack. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose text content makes xmt_text_content() pass the freed node to gf_node_get_tag(), reading freed heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134667 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory via over-long object descriptor URL fragments. Attackers can craft an XMT scene file whose URL fragment overflows the fixed 5000-byte szURL buffer via sprintf, crashing MP4Box when a user loads it.

item.title: CVE-2026-134668 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134669 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. Attackers can craft an XMT file whose ROUTE or command references a later-defined node, crashing MP4Box when a user imports it.

item.title: CVE-2026-134670 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that writes to freed heap memory when replacing single-node field commands. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file where a Conditional node owning the command is unregistered, corrupting heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134671 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. Attackers can persuade a user to process an XMT file whose discarded out-of-scope nodes cause gf_node_unregister() to dereference a freed child, crashing the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-134672 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_discard_subtree() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134673 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via stale strstr() pointers. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose MFURL field contains an entry without a URL string, causing sprintf() to read freed memory and crash the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-134674 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the post_lock, post_hide, post_pin and comment_hide handlers that allows inn moderators to act on content from other inns. Attackers can supply their own inn id with a foreign post or comment id to lock or hide content instance-wide, or pin private posts to expose titles.

item.title: CVE-2026-134675 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Servas before 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify and delete other users' data by supplying target resource ids. Attackers can abuse TagController update and destroy, LinkController destroy, and GroupController destroy actions to rename or delete tags and delete links and groups.

item.title: CVE-2026-134676 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_odm_disconnect() in src/compositor/object_manager.c caused by a deferred scene_ns_remove_object task holding a raw object manager pointer. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose commands delete a Background2D node, freeing the object manager early to crash the process and corrupt heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134677 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory via stale object descriptor links. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt_node_end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134678 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the edit_post_post handler for POST /post/edit/:pid that skips ownership and status checks when a Private inn is submitted. Members of a Private inn can overwrite any post by sequential id, including moderator-locked posts, re-attributing it to themselves and destroying original content.

item.title: CVE-2026-134679 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

item.title: CVE-2026-134680 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in TraverseForm() in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c due to an off-by-one groupsIndex bounds check. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a Form node having constraints but an empty groupsIndex field to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134681 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

item.title: CVE-2026-134682 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. A node shared across multiple PROTO node_code lists is freed by gf_sg_reset(), and gf_sg_proto_del() then calls gf_node_unregister() on the dangling pointer, crashing MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134683 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_remove_od_links_recursive() in loader_xmt.c that lacks any depth limit when walking node children. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with deeply nested or cyclic node and SFCommandBuffer references to exhaust the stack and crash MP4Box on import.

item.title: CVE-2026-134684 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves freed node URL fields in the pending object descriptor link list after SFNode replacement. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that reassigns a single-node field, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing the process and potentially corrupting the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-134685 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in load_xmt_done() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that reads freed nodes during XMT parser teardown. Attackers can craft an XMT scene with a scene replace command that destroys PROTO sub-graphs, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory when opened.

item.title: CVE-2026-134686 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf_node_register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134687 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134688 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the BT/XMT context loader that frees an interaction-type decoder-specific descriptor even when UIConfig re-encoding fails. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a BIFSConfig descriptor, causing gf_odf_delete_descriptor() to reuse and free it again, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134689 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript_LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml_js.c that reads unchecked script_text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134690 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134691 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_event_target_get_node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf_scene_disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134692 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c resolves DEF names without verifying the node belongs to the current scene graph. Attackers can craft an XMT scene reusing a PROTO node across graphs, causing gf_node_unregister() to read freed memory during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134693 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_create_node() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.

item.title: CVE-2026-134694 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Gammapy through 2.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in WcsGeom.from_header() that passes the WCSSHAPE FITS header card to eval(). Attackers can supply a crafted .fits file with a Python expression in WCSSHAPE, executing code as the user who loads it via Map.read().

item.title: CVE-2026-134695 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-134696 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF_SG_PROTO_DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.

item.title: CVE-2026-134697 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() that allows attackers to crash the application via indexed field-replace commands lacking a payload. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF_SG_XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.

item.title: CVE-2026-134698 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134699 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134700 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134701 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-134702 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-134703 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML_UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

item.title: CVE-2026-134704 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.
